injection_defense_from_policies takes mode/fail_mode from the first enabled injection_defense row in priority-DESC order across org and 'global' rows. A future global row that outranks an org row would silently override that org's tighten/enforce opt-in. No such global row is seeded today.

With inline on and enforce, a payload that only the deterministic scan flagged (no classifier call) is also withheld, as enforce_withholds_external_but_not_org_internal_or_mcp asserts. Switching an org to enforce therefore changes marker-hit handling too, not only semantic flags. This should be recorded in the ledger.

The call budget is per tool loop (run_tool_rounds_for_model_with_attachments), not per run. Gateway deep research and forced web search pass None/no inference bearer, so they never get the inline pass. This is the implementer's stated deviation from '6 calls/run'.

classify_within waits up to SCREENING_DEADLINE for a semaphore permit before starting the CONTENT_SAFETY_SEMANTIC_DEADLINE_MS classifier timeout. The worst-case added latency per external result is deadline + SCREENING_DEADLINE, not the configured deadline alone.
